name: DIALOG
recent: Dialog 近期宣布 Salbiah 气田开始产气，并计划再投资约 2.11 亿美元开发邻近的 Fatimah 气田。同时，EPF 与 KWAP 等主要股东在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔持股变动申报。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收与净利同比、环比均增长。
notable: 计划投资约 2.11 亿美元开发 Fatimah 气田。
EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月间有多笔持股变动申报。
risks: 主要股东 EPF 与 KWAP 在近期有多笔持股变动申报，需留意后续持股变化。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 MYR 774.555 百万，环比增长 11.2%，同比增长 27.3%；净利为 MYR 167.47 百万，环比增长 12.9%，同比增长 13.6%；净利率为 21.6%，高于上一季度的 21.3%。

recent_en: Dialog recently announced first gas from the Salbiah field and plans to invest about US$211 million to develop the nearby Fatimah field. Meanwhile, major shareholders EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings between October and November. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue and net profit grow both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: First gas achieved at the Salbiah field.
Plans to invest about US$211 million to develop the Fatimah field.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings between October and November.
risks_en: Major shareholders EPF and KWAP filed multiple shareholding changes recently; further changes in their holdings should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 774.555 million, up 11.2% qoq and 27.3% yoy; net profit was MYR 167.47 million, up 12.9% qoq and 13.6% yoy; net margin was 21.6%, up from 21.3% in the previous quarter.
